question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes a process driven by necessity.
 
• **"Fulfilled"** best fits the context because it suggests that the necessity is satisfied or met.
 
• This aligns with the idea of unrest continuing until the necessity is addressed.
 
• Hence, The correct blank is **'Fulfilled.'**

Therefore, The correct answer is** 'Option 4.'**

Correct sentence:__ Necessity is an (1__)__ **__irresistible__ **force that compels a man to do things. It stirs the mind so (2) __violently__ that it causes great unrest that continues until the necessity is (3) **__fulfilled__**. As order comes out of (4) ________ chaos so does an invention out of some (5) ________. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**Option (1) - Perturbed: **means disturbed or worried. While necessity can cause unrest, "perturbed" is a weaker term than "fulfilled" in the context of resolving the situation.

**Option (2) - Committed:** means dedicated or pledged. It doesn't convey the completion of addressing the necessity.

**Option (3) - Concerned:** means worried or anxious. Similar to "perturbed," it describes a state of unease rather than the resolution of the necessity.
